Amazingly BAD Thai food experience
Feb 2026 • Family
First night in Phu Quoc, first dinner on the island.
Amazing trip to Sabai Sabai.
13 family members came to dine at this restaurant.
The worst Thai Food Experience we ever had in our lives.
Dishes were small, taste was no way anything Thai, leaving the 
term “Authentic” - non-existent.
Plain Rice was half cooked or mushy. And rice is staple in Asia.
That gives you an idea of what to expect for the rest of my review.
Pandan chicken, went in my mouth and immediately out it come.
Same goes for their Thai Fish Cake. Tom Yum Soup is watered down, sweet,
with no hint of anything that is Tom Yum.

Avoid this restaurant. Went in feeling hungry, leaving hungry. And totally not worth the time and money.

And worst of all, some of our food was definitely uneatable! We found, among other things, whole pieces of garlic with garbage on in one of the dishes. 
I will in no way recommend this place to anyone. 
Save your money and find another place.

Thai food paradise 🇹🇭
Dec 2024 • Couples
If you’re looking for a magical dining experience in Phu Quoc, Sabai Sabai is the place to be. My husband and I had the most romantic evening here, complete with breathtaking sunset views overlooking the water. The staff went above and beyond to set up a beautifully decorated table for us, creating an intimate and serene atmosphere.

The restaurant’s decor is stunning, blending modern elegance with tropical charm. The ambiance, paired with the warm sea breeze and golden sunset, made it unforgettable. The staff were lovely and attentive, ensuring we felt welcome throughout the evening. The food came out quickly, and every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor.

We enjoyed the Fried Shrimp Paste coated in bread crumbs, which was perfectly crispy and flavorful. The Shrimp Pad Thai was rich and balanced, while the Spicy Ribs were tender and packed with heat. The Special Somtum was refreshingly vibrant, and the Mango Sticky Rice was the perfect way to end the meal—sweet, fragrant, and indulgent.

Sabai Sabai exceeded all expectations with its incredible food, stunning views, and exceptional service. This isn’t just a meal—it’s an experience you’ll treasure. Highly recommend!
